text:
nora: Heads-up: planning targetted v2 routing change for /beta/* routes next Tue night. Aim: minimal disruption, but need pin/rollback heuristics.

ishan: Proposed safety: only ramp tenants without active sdk versions older than 1.2.0. Auto-pin rule for any tenant that shows client-json-errors >0.5% in 10m.

lee: Ops asks: add per-tenant QPS soft cap during first 2 hours (default 50r/s) and a global surge reserve +15%. Also suggest 30m hold per step.

nora: rollout plan: 0.5% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100%, 30m steady window each, canary-bot to evaluate gates after each window.

canary-bot: gates configured: client_json_error_pct, error_rate_delta, p95_latency_ms. Alert channel set to #incidents and #release-handoff.

ishan: Rollback triggers: 
- client_json_error_pct delta >= 0.5% -> immediate pause + affected tenants pinned
- error_rate_delta >= 1.0% -> rollback to previous flag state
- p95_latency increase >= 250ms -> slow ramp (hold next step)

lee: Ops commands: `/rollout pause v2_beta_route` and `/rollout set v2_beta_route 0% --force --reason="rollback"`. Oncall will get pages.

cs-bot: CS template ready: includes tenant id, toggle link, suggested tenant message, and pinned_until. Manual unpin allowed after 24h subject to CS approval.

nora: Preflight checklist: schema, auth TTL, sdk header negotiation. Run `/deploybot preflight v2-beta --env=prod --dry-run` before kick.

deploy-bot: Preflight scheduled: 2026-04-20T20:00Z. Will post results here.

ishan: I'll prepare tenant pinlist and tag high-risk tenants as `sdk-legacy` so rollout service can skip them.

lee: I'll enable autoscale and set QPS caps before the cutover. Ops ready to monitor.

nora: If all green, schedule for 2026-04-21T01:30Z UTC. Leaving final approvals here.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: v2-beta-route-cutover-2026-04-21T01:30Z. Canary progress will be posted every 15m. Good luck!
